project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions + Auth HO (withAuth/withAdmin) + Zod + Audit Logs

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, services, service_categories. Settings: studio_info, employees, notification_preferences, audit_logs.

typography.exceptions: QuoteModernView branding (Watermark) uses hardcoded custom spacing/font weight.

components.ServiceMobileList: Compact row list with active expand state
components.QuoteModal: Compact, floating centered card (max-w 340px) vs V1 parity
components.VisualBuilder: Grid 7/5 Desktop, Single column Mobile, Canvas with GripVertical icons.
components.LayoutStandard: main-container (full-width), detail-grid (12 columns: 8/4 distribution for main/sidebar).

patterns.name: Explicit Field Selection for Privacy
patterns.details: Always avoid select('*') in server actions that fetch semi-public configuration or profile data to prevent leaking sensitive fields like OAuth tokens or internal metadata.

patterns.name: Ownership Validation in API/Actions
patterns.details: When a resource (e.g., notification) is accessed by ID, always include a filter or validation check against the authenticated user's ID to prevent IDOR vulnerabilities.

patterns.name: Server Actions Separation (Queries vs Mutations)
patterns.details: Read-only actions (settings-queries) employ withAuth/withAdmin but rarely need Zod. Mutating actions (settings-mutations) MUST have strict Zod validation via safeParse, optimistic locking handling, and invoke fireAuditLog immediately upon successful DB operation.

gotchas: z.ZodError objects expose an .issues array (not .errors). Use parsed.error.issues[0]?.message for formatting safeParse errors.
employees table often lacks columns present in older V1 schemas (e.g., bank info, salary context). Always verify against current DB schema before coding actions.
Layout Centering Trap: Avoiding max-w-[px] classes on main layout wrappers to maintain consistency with the full-width Gold Standard dashboard.
